highlights_headline: Upcoming 4.154 builds package XML API documentation and synchronize generated native bindings with bundled sources.
highlights_body: NuGet consumers receive API documentation sidecars alongside the packages, while generated interop stays aligned with the bundled Skia and HarfBuzz sources.

bullets.lead: XML API documentation ships with NuGet packages
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp packages now include XML documentation sidecars, so IDE tooltips and API reference information are available directly to package consumers.
